description: Isolith CATIA/SolidWorks editor parity baseline. Decision #19 sets the product bar: same-or-greater editor functionality than CATIA/SolidWorks for the working engineer. This register stops being an exclusion list and becomes the PARITY BASELINE inventory an engineer reads to judge whether Isolith covers their main job. Machine-checkable copy of docs/scope-register.md. Every row carries a current-status token (not-scoped / planned / building / shippable) and evidence; a row may NOT claim a status higher than a green accepted test proves (honest-claims discipline, enforced by python/oep_tooling/scope_register_check.py and tests/test_scope_register.py).

policy.product_bar: same-or-greater editor functionality than CATIA/SolidWorks for the working engineer (decision #19, 2026-10-22)
policy.honesty_rule: no row may claim a status higher than a green accepted test proves
